goal: Create a bounded public-link traversal capability for the current free-for-dev learning task: from a parent public HTTP(S) page and its HTML, extract and normalize relevant HTTP(S) links with provenance, reject non-HTTP schemes, remove fragments and duplicates, and keep the result bounded. Produce a fresh Python module rather than editing an existing source seed.
repair: Capture the complete href including #fragment, then strip the fragment after URL parsing so deduplication operates on normalized URLs. The repair must tolerate ast.unparse quote/escape serialization.
pass_only_if: fresh candidate Python source is emitted with no source seed
all five fresh functional tests pass
claim_boundary: Success proves the repaired host-authored bounded seedless writer can let YADO materialize a new supported Python module from a high-level goal. It does not prove open-ended arbitrary programming or that YADO invented the writer itself.
